## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Problem / Use Case

What problem does this feature solve? Who would benefit from it?

Example: "As a [user type], I want [goal] so that [benefit]."

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working. Include:

- UI mockups or wireframes (if applicable)
- API changes (if applicable)
- User flow

## Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any alternative solutions or workarounds?

## Alignment with SudoMeet Vision

Does this feature align with SudoMeet's goals?

- [ ] Dark-mode-first design
- [ ] Developer-focused platform
- [ ] Open-source alternative to Google Meet
- [ ] Free-tier friendly (Vercel/Neon/Upstash/LiveKit community plans)
- [ ] Media-provider abstraction (works with both P2P and LiveKit)

## Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, or references about the feature request here.

## Implementation Notes

(Optional) If you have technical ideas on how to implement this, share them here:

- Which files/modules would need changes?
- External dependencies required?
- Compatibility with Tier A (P2P) and Tier B (LiveKit)?
